name: simple-backend-architecture-fastify
description: Fastify implementation of the `simple-backend-architecture-showcase` project. This repository implements a simple backend API using **Fastify**, **TypeScript**, **MongoDB**, **Mongoose**, **Zod** and **JWT authentication**. The domain is intentionally simple: users can register, login and manage their own todos.   The main goal is to showcase clean backend architecture, request validation, authentication middleware and ownership-based access control.
author: Vincenzo Brasca
